scope: SP500 M30 ATR runner from v3 only; no parameter, signal, cost or exit changes
disclosure: The aggregate v3 result, top-ten removal, and 3R/5R cap totals were inspected before this contract. Concentration detail, declared Monte Carlo outcomes, retrospective partition detail, and new Exness September holdout were not used to select parameters.

monte_carlo.tail_definition: trade net R strictly greater than 3R
outputs: median and 95 percent interval of total R
median and 95 percent interval of missed tail count
one-percent fixed-fraction final-equity multiple and maximum drawdown

temporal_partitions.new_holdout_role: Pristine post-v3 SP500 exit outcome diagnostic; too short to confirm or reject edge alone

new_holdout.history_source: existing 2022-08/2026 Exness M1 cache plus read-only MT5 September extension
new_holdout.entry_and_exit: unchanged v3 causal Lorentzian M30 and ATR runner
new_holdout.minimum_trade_interpretation: report all trades; no pass/fail conclusion from fewer than 30

tail_structure_supported_if: greater-than-3R winners occur in every annual group
under ten-percent independent tail miss probability at least 80 percent of simulations remain positive
assessment.unseen_holdout: reported separately and never allowed to override the historical tail assessment

forbidden: reclassifying the posthoc cap diagnostic as preregistered
treating September fewer-than-30 trades as confirmation
